testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-account-inheritance.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-31704 child account inherits the parent sales rep when inheritance is enabled

scenario.summary: A parent account with a sales rep and Enable Sales Rep Inheritance = Yes; the admin creates a child account under it without a sales rep; the child's Manage Account shows the parent's sales rep.
steps: Go to Accounts and Users > Accounts; open the parent account (@parent.accountName) and add a child account (name and code made up by the test) without selecting a Sales Rep; save.
Open Manage Account of the child account; read the Sales Rep field.
stateChanges: Creates a child account under @parent (created by the test; the test deletes it at the end, before the parent's teardown).
assertions: The child account's Sales Rep is @rep.fullName
evidence: Story Z10-38546 (SalesRep - Phase 2, account association), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-38546/analysis.md sections 3-4 and answers in section 6.
FSD section 4 (Enable Sales Rep Inheritance, evaluated at child creation) and section 5 Scenario 1 (inheritance enabled).
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store the migrated suites run on (store A), as in the Phase 1 tests.
ACCOUNT_OF_STORE, CHILD_ACCOUNT_OF_ACCOUNT and USER_OF_ACCOUNT are new consumable keys (analysis section 4, pending approval; collections still to build through the account and customer APIs).
The child account is created in the UI by the test (analysis section 3, P2-B), not a need.
Admin session: the suite's saved admin session (admin.setup.ts), a credential, not a need.
